newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Schiphol freight message system use rises in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Schiphol freight message system use rises in 1995.

text.p: Cargonaut, the electronic messaging system for the Dutch airfreight industry, recorded significantly more use last year than in previous years, its operators said in a statement.

Cargonaut BV, the Schiphol-based software house which developed the system, said in 1995 there was an 18 percent growth in messaging traffic. Over 1.3 million messages were transmitted by airfreight users, it said.

The biggest reported rise airfreight status messages, up 33 percent, to a total of 170,000. Reservation messages were up 25 percent and the electronic exchange of airway bills climbed 13 percent, Cargonaut said.
Growth in the number of import declarations was smaller than in previous years, but still climbed nine percent, to a total of 384,000.
Some 70 forwarding agents and the 15 top cargo airlines are the co-shareholders and users of the Cargonaut system. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
